meta_title: Mobila Car Auto Electrician | Auto Electrician Manchester
meta_description: Mobila Car Auto Electrician offers expert auto electrical services across Manchester. Fast diagnostics, same-day repairs, and honest pricing. Call us today.
hero_eyebrow: Qualified Auto Electrician — Same-Day Diagnostics & Repairs
hero_subhead: Electrical faults don't wait — get a fast, reliable diagnosis and fix from a specialist you can trust today.
services_heading: Complete Auto Electrical Services Across Manchester
services_subhead: From fault diagnostics to full wiring repairs, we cover every auto electrical need for cars, vans, and light commercial vehicles.

services.title: Auto Electrical Diagnostics
services.desc: We use professional-grade diagnostic equipment to pinpoint faults fast, saving you time and unnecessary parts costs. Whether it's a warning light or an intermittent fault, we'll find the cause.

services.title: Battery Testing & Replacement
services.desc: A failing battery can leave you stranded without warning. We test your battery on-site and supply and fit a quality replacement to get you back on the road swiftly.

services.title: Starter Motor & Alternator Repair
services.desc: If your car struggles to start or your battery keeps draining, a faulty starter or alternator is often to blame. We repair and replace both with parts built to last.

services.title: ECU Diagnostics & Repair
services.desc: Engine management faults can affect performance, economy, and emissions. Our ECU diagnostics identify fault codes accurately so the right repair is carried out first time.

services.title: Wiring & Electrical Fault Finding
services.desc: Damaged or corroded wiring causes a wide range of electrical gremlins. We trace and repair wiring faults thoroughly, restoring full electrical function to your vehicle.

services.title: Central Locking & Alarm Systems
services.desc: Whether your central locking has stopped responding or your alarm is misfiring, we diagnose and repair both factory-fitted and aftermarket systems efficiently.

about_pullquote: Every vehicle gets the same attention I'd give my own car.
about_para_1: Mobila Car Auto Electrician was founded in Manchester with one aim: to provide honest, skilled auto electrical work that local drivers can actually rely on. Based on Blackley New Road, we serve customers across Manchester and the surrounding areas, bringing specialist knowledge and professional equipment to every job.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is our commitment to transparency — we explain exactly what's wrong and what it will cost before any work begins. Our customers return to us time and again because they know they'll get a straight answer, a proper fix, and a fair price every single time.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Drivers Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant service from start to finish. Had a nightmare with my car's electrics for weeks and other garages couldn't find the fault. Mobila diagnosed it within the hour and had it fixed the same day. Genuinely impressed.
reviews.author: James T.

reviews.text: Really professional and honest. He told me exactly what the problem was, gave me a fair price, and didn't try to upsell anything unnecessary. My central locking works perfectly now. Would highly recommend to anyone in Manchester.
reviews.author: Priya S.

reviews.text: Sorted my alternator out quickly and at a price that was much better than the main dealer quoted me. Friendly, knowledgeable, and didn't make me feel like I was being fobbed off. Will definitely be back if I need anything else.
reviews.author: Dave H.
